newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-ITALY CALL ON LOMBARDO, DEL PIERO FIT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ITALY CALL ON LOMBARDO, DEL PIERO FIT.

text.p: Veteran Juventus midfielder Attilio Lombardo was called up by Italy on Monday for the four-nation Tournoi de France, starting on Tuesday.
He replaced Piacenza's Eusebio Di Francesco, needed by his club for the serie A relegation playoff against Cagliari on June 14 or 15.
Roma-bound Di Francesco was the first Piacenza player to receive an international call.
Juventus striker Alessandro Del Piero passed a late fitness test after being hit in the face by the ball during the European Cup final last week.
Team officials said Del Piero, who saw a specialist about the retina of his left eye, would still be rested for two days as a precaution.
Midfielder Demetrio Albertini would leave the squad after Italy's game against Brazil on June 8 for a minor operation that has been planned for some time.
